mcqs.question: From which date did the Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 come into force, replacing the 2016 rules?
mcqs.explanation: The Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 came into force on April 1, 2026, replacing the Solid Waste Management Rules 2016. The most tempting wrong option is 2016, which refers to the year of the rules that were replaced, not their effective date.
